summary: Backend: 27/27 pytest pass (existing test_noonelistening_api.py + new test_noonelistening_extra.py). Covered: session, vent (text/audio/invalid kind), echo/chat via Emergent key with Claude model (reply+mood, empty/whitespace 400, voice_mode), multi-turn memory (recalled 'Biscuit'), history ordering and no _id, mood classifier for all 5 labels plus edge inputs ('', whitespace, '?', gibberish, emoji, 3000 chars) which always return 200 with a valid mood, so the IndexError fix holds. voice/speak returns 500 'voice key not configured' as expected. Frontend (desktop 1920 + mobile 390): Splash -> Enter -> Home (code shown, identity saved in localStorage) -> Echo chat (send button and Enter key, typing indicator, mood badge, 2-turn memory 'Mara' recalled, history comes back after reload) -> Empty Room (text release dissolves, POST /vent 200; Speak mode starts recording with the headless fake mic) -> Exit modal stay -> Voice screen (pick male saves pref, begin -> LISTENING, end -> home) -> Farewell (reminder toggle shows 'notifications blocked' in headless, go back in -> /home, leave -> /). No console errors and no failed API calls.

minor.issue: session_id is never checked against the sessions collection, so any string is accepted and stored
Each message makes 2 LLM calls in series (mood, then reply), which adds latency. They could run in parallel.

integration_issues.issue: Leave only calls navigate('/'). clearIdentity() is exported but never used, so the same session and chat history stay after 'leaving'. This contradicts the copy 'The room forgets so you don't have to.' Product decision.

issues: Mono uppercase labels at 10px with text-muted on a near-black background (top-bar back/close, splash tagline, home section labels, empty-room hint) have very low contrast and are hard to read

action_items: Optional: decide whether 'leave the room' should clearIdentity() before navigating to '/'
Optional: raise the contrast of text-muted micro labels
critical_code_review_comments: _ask_llm Emergent branch passes the system prompt both as system_message and inside initial_messages. This is harmless because initial_messages overrides, but it is redundant.
The old backend log line 'mood classification failed: list index out of range' is from before the fix and did not happen again during testing
